R2_review-1.classification: Shared evidence-admission defect; local rows and stale remote rows cannot prove fleet-wide ownership or satisfaction.
R2_review-1.invariant: Without a fleet list no older than six hours, ownership stays UNKNOWN and dependency satisfaction is forbidden while visible open rows still block.

task_kinds.inspection: fm_blocked_by_row_states and fm-pr-owner do not select by kind; prep-scout versus build-ship collisions are explicit regressions. fm-autolaunch.sh:spawn_argv retains its existing scout/ship split. Persistent secondmate ownership is selected through .fm-secondmate-home in the sweep and through the existing registry parser for triage; no secondmate lifecycle is added.

harnesses.inspection: Inspected fm-harness.sh supported values and the fm-send.sh durable text/doorbell boundary and fm-control.sh relaunch handoff. Changed verdicts use only row/census/ledger data before those boundaries; no vendor rendering, prompt, keybind, account, model or harness classification changes. The same data-boundary tests apply to every listed harness.
harnesses.gap: No live harness guard was run in this review. The inspected control guard exercises Claude/Herdr exit behavior, not fleet-data admission; live proof must not be inferred from command-recording fakes.

backends.inspection: Inspected bin/fm-backend.sh known/spawn sets, fm-control.sh relaunch paths, fm-send.sh text delivery and fm-on.sh remote entrypoint contract. All decisions added here precede the existing backend dispatch. Local registered homes and SSH-registered homes use the same selected-home check. No endpoint, backend pin or worktree ownership changes.
backends.gap: No real backend or SSH fleet transport exercised. The T3 guard covers native PR-tool attachment rather than this row-based lookup; it is not substituted for the ownership regression. codex-app is absent from the supported backend set and remains unchanged.

platforms.inspection: Fixed freshness arithmetic remains in portable awk and Bash; fm_blocked_by_iso retains GNU date -d then BSD date -r formatting. Row extraction still uses existing Perl and does not depend on terminal signals. No platform-specific runtime operation changed.
platforms.gap: Focused verification runs on this Linux worktree only. macOS Bash/date behavior is inspected but not executed here.

account_selection.inspection: fm-pr-owner.sh still reads an unspecified branch with the existing gh seam; mark still validates merge state through gh. Triages prelisted branches and preserves its existing GitHub read/write split. fm-control.sh relaunch and fm-autolaunch.sh dispatch/quota/account selection are downstream and unchanged. No credential, environment configuration, key, profile or account pin is written.
account_selection.gap: Forge and capacity/control boundaries are fixture-recorded; no authenticated GitHub or account failover live proof.

lifecycle_transitions: fresh list -> absent/stale: open blockers remain blocked, all satisfaction and definitive PR ownership become UNKNOWN
absent/stale -> fresh: eligible done/archive/mark edges may satisfy again and unique PR ownership may become known
queued -> ready withheld -> ready after fresh evidence
main orphan wake; candidate secondmate UNKNOWN wake; noncandidate secondmate silence
exited/released-copy local task -> guarded relaunch only after known local ownership
known remote task -> one-way steer only to selected registered home; ambiguous/unreadable/done owner -> refusal
mark -> repeated mark no-op -> reopened row blocks -> unmark restores unresolved edge
dry run -> no control/send/forge writes; repeated pass -> unchanged verdicts and no duplicate steer/launch
